title: Programmer Art Expanded
description: Adds textures from after 1.14, with the Programmer Art feel!
body:
This resource pack aims to replicate the feeling of the Programmer Art texture pack, but including new blocks that came after 1.14! This is still in the early stages, but I plan updating it as soon as new blocks are added.

**Blocks and Items Included**
- Soul Fire
- Deepslate
- Deepslate Ores
- Copper Ore & Deepslate Copper Ore
- Nether Gold Ore
